correction_effect.section: GR transfer learning with common spatial patterns
correction_effect.summary: The original paragraph duplicated the CSP-Expert-Subject score for two comparison decoders. The correction retains Expert-Subject 0.3727 ± 0.2924 and changes Subject-Specific-Fix to 0.2120 ± 0.2815 and Subject-Specific-Adapt to 0.2515 ± 0.3082, each N=144, retaining the reported P values. These source-paper reported values are not results from this repository.
correction_effect.current_study_action: Cite original with correction; do not import original-paper scores into present frozen analysis. No change to current frozen data/model/protocol identities is indicated by this textual correction.
